name: regression-tool-call-identity
goal: Pair unchanged regression runs across separate Codex tool calls while retaining meaningful environment settings.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Two current tool calls changed only CODEX_TOOL_CALL_ID in the relevant profile: full hashes differed while hashes with that identifier omitted matched.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing environment profile case covers launcher and resource lease identities but omits the per-tool-call identifier; extend that same case without adding tests.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only 620840da8d failed record 785ad7b459e5 because differing per-call identifiers changed an otherwise identical profile.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 1fee21a175 excludes only CODEX_TOOL_CALL_ID from the comparison while retaining runtime and other environment values.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Red 785ad7b459e5 and green 66b8bc345abf used the same committed test and environment; workload settings remain in the profile.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
